title: PR checks do not run the Pages build, so a Pages-only break is first seen at the deploy gate
evidence: npm run build:pages (vite.config.standalone.ts swaps upload-api.ts for byok-upload.ts) runs at deploy, not on PRs. PR 1442 round 1 exported a constant from upload-api.ts that upload-pipeline.ts imported; under the Pages swap that import broke (round 1 review finding), and no PR check showed it. Adding build:pages to PR CI is a .github/workflows change, Brad's to make
